name: vacuum_multixact_freeze_min_age
description: Minimum age (in number of multixact IDs) at which VACUUM freezes a MultiXactId in a table row to prevent wraparound.
symptoms: Bloat due to unfrozen multixact entries
Query failures with 'cannot freeze tuples' error
tuning_tips: Set lower than autovacuum_multixact_freeze_max_age (ideally ≤ half) to allow proactive freezing before forced autovacuum; increase only if excessive freezing causes I/O pressure during normal VACUUM.
